description: Expected value of a wager from odds and your own win probability (percent, 0-100). EV = stake * (p*(decimal-1) - (1-p)); break-even probability = 1/decimal; edge = p - break-even. The probability is your input, not a prediction by BetsBeats. For adults 21+ only. Entertainment and analysis; no wins are promised and past results do not predict future ones. BetsBeats does not take bets.

stake.description: Stake for the EV amount. Default 100.

win_probability_percent.description: Your estimated chance of winning, 0-100 exclusive.
